design.structure: Three-Arm Hypothesis 1 Directional Assay across 3 Seeds (9 Lineages Total)

arms.description: Baseline unconditioned recipient substrate with zero PFM events ingested.
Targeted Zone-9 constitutive PFM conditioning across 1,152 sequential blocks.
Event-matched non-terminal 5-pole manifold conditioning across 1,152 sequential blocks with strict 0 Zone-9 contact.

strictRecipientCheckpointMatching.rule: Every arm (D0, D1152-Z9, D1152-NEUTRAL) within seed s MUST hydrate into an identical base recipient state checkpoint before PFM constitutive bias application. Shared recipient state digest MUST be identical across all 3 arms for a given seed s.

neutralArmEquivalenceAndZeroZ9.rule: D1152-NEUTRAL must match D1152-Z9 exactly in event count (1,152), step duration, temporal placement, trace totals, runtime exposure, and declared memory-magnitude norm (L1 strain sum = 1.0), with STRICTLY ZERO Zone-9 exposure events (count == 0, percentage == 0.0%).

deterministicBlindedChallenge.blindedApplication: Identical pre-computed perturbation schedule applied to all 3 arms within the same seed.

allSeedDirectionalPassRule.rule: Hypothesis 1 passes IF AND ONLY IF for ALL THREE seeds s in {101, 202, 303} simultaneously: (1) Zone9Pct(D1152_Z9, s) > Zone9Pct(D1152_NEUTRAL, s) AND (2) Zone9Pct(D1152_Z9, s) > Zone9Pct(D0, s). Zero sign reversals allowed. Means are strictly non-authorising without full 3/3 individual seed compliance.

executionSequence: 1. Verify known-answer cryptographic SHA-256 test vectors against canonicalSha256.
2. Execute 9 lineages (3 arms × 3 seeds) and append-seal raw observation capsules immediately to disk at audit_archive/paper6_v2_1_raw_sealed_capsules.jsonl.
3. Verify on-disk presence and SHA-256 integrity of all 9 raw sealed capsules before computing any contrast, aggregate, or score.
4. Fail-close and abort execution immediately if disk write or SHA-256 integrity verification fails.
